## Changes since v0.9.1

### External MCP, Skill, and host plugins

- Add the read-only `figure_library_list_catalog` tool, increasing the standard MCP tool set from 61 to 62. It reuses the browse result set (same Provider filters, catalog revision and Library binding checks), returns per-Provider counts and plotFamily/language/assetKind facets, and lists one line per template; listed candidateIds work with `figure_library_get_candidate_images` and the headless exact preview. It returns no images, selectors or receipts.
- Make catalog selection the default retrieval path for described needs. `limit: 0` returns counts and facets only; the default `detail: "compact"` groups entries by Provider with a 60-character summary (about 29% fewer tokens than `"full"`). Keyword search with no match now points the Agent to catalog selection instead of concluding that a figure type is missing.
- Add canonical figure-type groups: a read-only projection maps Open Figure Modules' 71 plotFamily spellings and FigureYa modules without one to 29 groups, exposed as a `familyGroup` facet, entry field and filter. Stored metadata, selectors and the keyword-search plotFamily filter are unchanged.
- Let Agents read the catalog once per session: the listing returns `catalogRevision` (also as a `CATALOG_REVISION:` text line), a `limit: 0` call checks whether an earlier read is still current, and a new `templates` filter (1–12 providerId/templateId pairs) re-lists chosen entries under a fresh resultSetId.
- Add `SFL_TOOL_PROFILE` for MCP configuration: `use` registers 28 tools (about 24 KB of schemas instead of about 72 KB), `author` adds intake, review and the Local Published lifecycle (46 tools), and `full` (default, unchanged) registers every tool. Unknown values stop startup, and a reduced profile is named in the server instructions so the Agent asks the user to switch instead of imitating a hidden tool.
- Fix keyword ranking: two-letter terms such as KM/HR match whole words instead of substrings (FPKM no longer matches KM), hits made only of generic words (plot, figure, gene) score zero, domain families such as single-cell no longer outrank chart forms, and a UMAP/tSNE embedding family was added.
- Fix proxied HTTPS through the loopback CONNECT proxy sending `Host: api.github.com:80`, which GitHub answered with HTTP 400 and which broke update checks, the network diagnostic and proxied archive/manifest downloads.
- Wisp, Claude, Codex and Cursor plugin ZIPs no longer bundle gallery images; like npm and local packages they ship pinned preview-download manifests and fetch previews on demand through the same proxy settings. Each plugin ZIP drops from 27.6 MB to 2.7 MB. Without GitHub access, search still returns candidates and images report `preview_unavailable`.
- Update the Skill, workflow reference, PROTOCOL, user guides and packaged tool inventories for these behaviors.

### Local clients

- The Windows/Linux local web client loads gallery and 我的图库 card thumbnails (≤480 px) lazily from authenticated, immutable-cached URLs instead of inlining full-resolution base64 images in the gallery JSON. Exact preview and local confirmation still hash the exact displayed bytes; MCP tools, the MCP App and the macOS client keep inline data URLs.

### Gallery, cache, and library browsing

- Cut local gallery and reference-status latency: memoize Local Published listing entries per exact Published Head identity (revalidated against series files and file signatures on each call), build local search candidates from the listing instead of a full history resolve per match, hash the large FigureYa catalog revision once per revision, and check reference-cache status once per request with per-candidate checks in parallel.
- Preserve exact asset identities, preview confirmation and plan/apply boundaries. SFL does not execute plotting code; automated tests and smoke do not replace manual acceptance on a user's device or external host.

### Documentation

- Record the 2026-10 optimization review, its decisions and the retrieval rounds, including the decision to stop semantic-card work; add a design-only proposal for a shorter materialization path (not implemented); remove completed worktree specs and one-off QA notes.

## 相对 v0.9.1 的变化

### 外部 MCP、Skill 与宿主插件

- 新增只读工具 `figure_library_list_catalog`，标准 MCP 工具从 61 个增加到 62 个。它复用浏览结果集（同样的 Provider 过滤、目录 revision 与图库绑定检查），返回各 Provider 计数及 plotFamily/language/assetKind 分面，每个模板一行；列出的 candidateId 可直接用于 `figure_library_get_candidate_images` 和 headless 精确预览。不返回图片、选择器或凭据。
- 对描述性需求，目录选择成为默认检索路径。`limit: 0` 仅返回计数与分面；默认 `detail: "compact"` 按 Provider 分组并给出 60 字符摘要，比 `"full"` 少约 29% token。关键词搜索无结果时会引导 Agent 改用目录选择，而非断定图库缺少该图型。
- 新增规范图型分组：只读投影将 Open Figure Modules 的 71 种 plotFamily 写法及缺少该字段的 FigureYa 模块映射到 29 个分组，以 `familyGroup` 分面、条目字段和过滤器提供。存储的元数据、选择器和关键词搜索的 plotFamily 过滤保持不变。
- 支持会话内只读一次目录：清单返回 `catalogRevision`（同时输出 `CATALOG_REVISION:` 文本行），用 `limit: 0` 即可判断之前读取的结果是否仍然有效；新增 `templates` 过滤器（1–12 个 providerId/templateId），可在新的 resultSetId 下只重新列出选中的条目。
- 新增 MCP 配置项 `SFL_TOOL_PROFILE`：`use` 注册 28 个工具（schema 约 24 KB，原约 72 KB），`author` 增加导入、审阅与 Local Published 生命周期（46 个工具），`full`（默认，行为不变）注册全部工具。未知取值会阻止启动；精简配置会写入服务端说明，Agent 应请用户切换，而不是模仿未注册的工具。
- 修复关键词排序：KM/HR 等两字母词改为整词匹配（FPKM 不再命中 KM）；仅由通用词（plot、figure、gene）构成的命中计为零分；单细胞等领域类不再压过图表形式，并新增 UMAP/tSNE 降维嵌入分组。
- 修复经回环 CONNECT 代理访问时发送 `Host: api.github.com:80`，导致 GitHub 返回 HTTP 400，进而使更新检查、网络诊断和经代理的归档/清单下载失败的问题。
- Wisp、Claude、Codex、Cursor 插件 ZIP 不再打包图库图片，与 npm 和本地安装包一样只携带固定版本的预览下载清单，按需并按相同代理设置下载预览。每个插件包从 27.6 MB 降至 2.7 MB；无法访问 GitHub 时搜索仍返回候选，图片报告 `preview_unavailable`。
- 同步更新 Skill、工作流参考、PROTOCOL、用户手册与打包工具清单。

### 本地客户端

- Windows/Linux 本地网页的图库和“我的图库”卡片缩略图（≤480 px）改为从经认证、可长期缓存的 URL 懒加载，不再在图库 JSON 中内联全分辨率 base64 图片。精确预览和本地确认仍对实际显示的字节计算哈希；MCP 工具、MCP App 与 macOS 客户端仍使用内联 data URL。

### 图库、缓存与本地浏览

- 降低本地图库与引用状态延迟：按精确 Published Head 身份缓存 Local Published 列表条目（每次调用按 series 文件与文件签名重新校验）；本地搜索从列表构建候选，不再对每个命中做完整历史解析；大型 FigureYa 目录 revision 每个版本只计算一次哈希；引用缓存状态每次请求只检查一次结果集，并行检查各候选。
- 保留精确资产身份、预览确认与 plan/apply 边界。SFL 不执行绘图代码；自动化测试与 smoke 不替代用户设备或真实外部宿主上的人工验收。

### 文档

- 记录 2026-10 优化评审的决策与两轮检索评估（包括停止语义卡片工作的决定）；新增仅为设计稿的更短材料化路径方案（未实现）；移除已完成的 worktree spec 和一次性 QA 记录。
